title: Saistītais dokuments
text: LETTER OF AUTHORIZATION I, Andris Kulbergs, Prime Minister, hereby certify that Jānis Vitenbergs, Minister for Climate and Energy, is authorized to sign the Social Climate Fund Agreement between the European Commission and the Republic of Latvia, on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Latvia.   In witness whereof, I have signed these presents and caused the official seal to be affixed hereunder.
